# oneuptime_kubernetes_cost_allocation_data (Data Source)

Kubernetes cost allocation data data source

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "oneuptime_kubernetes_cost_allocation_data" "example" {
  name = "example-kubernetes_cost_allocation_data"
}
```
